# Add Strings.

@example 2718 + 394 = 3112: the two numbers line up at their last digits.
"2718"
"394"
=> "3112"

@example 9990 + 35 = 10025: a carry leaves the top column, so the sum is one digit longer than either number.
"9990"
"35"
=> "10025"

@example Adding zero changes nothing.
"0"
"604"
=> "604"

# Zero plus zero is "0", not "" or "00".
"0"
"0"
=> "0"

# Single digits, without and with a carry.
"5"
"4"
=> "9"

"9"
"1"
=> "10"

# A long number plus zero, with the zero second.
"80700600500400300200100"
"0"
=> "80700600500400300200100"

# The carry stops at the top digit: the sum is no longer than the longer number.
"1999998"
"2"
=> "2000000"

# A carry runs through every 9 of the longer number and out of the top.
"1"
"999999"
=> "1000000"

# A carry runs through the 9s of the shorter number into the longer one.
"99999"
"123456789"
=> "123556788"

# No column carries at all.
"123456789"
"876543210"
=> "999999999"

# 2^63 - 1 plus 1: one past the largest long long.
"9223372036854775807"
"1"
=> "9223372036854775808"

# 2^64 - 1 plus 1: one past the largest unsigned long long.
"18446744073709551615"
"1"
=> "18446744073709551616"

# 1000 fives plus 1000 fives: every column carries, and so does the top.
""
""
=> ""

# Random small cases from gen.c (lc check --regen makes them).
@gen 1 small
"5"
"909"
=> "914"

@gen 2 small
"83532"
"16468"
=> "100000"

@gen 3 small
"723910"
"276090"
=> "1000000"

@gen 4 small
"0"
"14827"
=> "14827"

@gen 5 small
"7999"
"99"
=> "8098"

@gen 6 small
"9999"
"9999"
=> "19998"

@gen 8 small
"792"
"208"
=> "1000"

@gen 9 small
"4972"
"99999"
=> "104971"
